callText: Elderly male, toothache and cold sweat

caller.voice: His wife, worried, in casual Singapore English. She knows only what she has seen: her husband is 63 and has had a bad toothache for about 40 minutes while resting, and now he has a cold sweat. He has high cholesterol, no heart problem and no heart medicine.

answers.whatHappened: My husband, 63. He was sitting down resting, then he say his tooth very pain. 40 minutes already. Now he got cold sweat, sweating a lot.
answers.conscious: Conscious, he can talk, but the pain very bad.
answers.icAndMeds: OK, I get his IC ready. He got high cholesterol, but no heart medicine.

patient.name: Koh Ah Seng
patient.voice: Pale and sweaty, speaks in full sentences, rubs his jaw.
patient.chiefComplaint: My tooth very pain, here at the jaw. Now my left arm also pain.

lines.feelingNow: Breathing a bit easier now. But my jaw and my arm still pain.
lines.fall: No, I never fall. I was sitting down the whole time.
lines.hitHead: No, I never hit my head.
lines.lungHistory: No, no asthma, no lung problem. Never had heart problem also.
lines.verbal: Koh Ah Seng. I'm at home, in Clementi.
lines.motor: OK, both arms up, like this.
lines.severity: 7. My tooth and my jaw very pain.
lines.position: I sit here on the sofa like this, OK.
lines.bpScreen: No shunt, no fistula. Never had operation.
lines.ic: My IC is in my pocket, here.

scene.description: Living room, tea on the table
hazards: hot tea on the table beside the patient

loc.response: Yes, I can hear you. My tooth very pain.

spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and strong

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, breath sounds clear

ecg.reading: Sinus tachycardia about 104, ST elevation in V2 to V4

oxygen.note: A chest pain patient gets high-flow oxygen: a non-rebreather at 10 to 15 L/min. Never withhold oxygen (notes 17).
